string.text: SortingPlus favourite/junk MCM keybinds (K/J) and remember lists across new games.
Toggle favourite on the hovered inventory item. Default K. Unbind to disable.
Toggle junk on the hovered inventory item. Default J. Unbind to disable.
Keep favourite item types in your profile so they apply on new games. Off = save-only like stock SortingPlus.
Keep junk item types in your profile so they apply on new games. Off = save-only like stock SortingPlus.
